title: Harden canonical reader browser parity and rapid-scroll runtime

sourceRefs.summary: Approved 20-slice Safari/WebKit and rapid-scroll hardening detour with exact predecessor restoration boundary.

verificationRecords.scope: Slice 1 control-plane status derives the new 20-slice hardening contract while the predecessor remains stored at slice 14.
Slice 1 separate hardening contract, active priority checkpoint, source-linked target done contract, and stored predecessor are graph-valid.

Slice 2 Playwright WebKit 26.5 canonical fraction-reader smoke: measured cancellation motif, wide and phone paint, direct seek, rewind, exclusive authority, endpoints, fit evidence, and review launcher passed.
verificationRecords.notes: The run also exposed existing asynchronous phone-stage readable-floor diagnostics, retained for baseline classification in slices 3-5; they did not fail the canonical motif contract.

verificationRecords.scope: Slice 2 Playwright WebKit project and scoped browser-contract scripts typecheck across application, Node, test, and domain projects.

verificationRecords.notes: Typed runtime metrics and browser harness compile across app, node, tests, and domains.

30-frame bidirectional trace passed; baseline identified 28 canonical session builds, 6758.8 ms aggregate build time, 13 frames over 50 ms, approximately 533 ms p95, zero scroll-geometry recompiles, and zero material-owner add/remove churn.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 04 deterministic Chromium baseline, repeated twice
verificationRecords.notes: Both repetitions produced the frozen 30-frame work counters: 0 scroll-geometry reads, 30 anchor reads, 28 session builds, 2 reuses, 30 applies, and 0 material-owner additions or removals. Frame timing remains attached evidence rather than an environment-dependent baseline allowance.

Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit each passed twice with equivalent observables and the exact 0/30/28/2/30 geometry-anchor-build-reuse-apply counters plus zero material-owner churn. Long Task API support is Chromium-only; frame intervals remain the portable timing signal. The prior WebKit phone readable-floor diagnostic is classified as shared responsive-fit debt, not a browser-specific compositor divergence.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 06 total branded geometry cache identity
verificationRecords.notes: Factory validation and exhaustive single-authority invalidation tests passed; compile-time fixture rejects an omitted DPR authority.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 06 nominal identity and negative compile fixture
verificationRecords.notes: All application, Node, test, and domain projects passed.
Passed below the unchanged ceiling at 49,928 types, 66,215 instantiations, and 2.32 seconds check time.
Cache retains measured anchor until explicit invalidation and preserves prior typed identity tests.
Rapid 30-frame sweep now performs zero scroll-geometry and zero viewport-anchor layout reads after warm-up; session rebuild baseline remains deliberately unchanged for later slices.
Application, Node, tests, and domains compile.
Eight focused tests pass, including latest-input coalescing, read-plan-write ordering, separate invalidation, direct renderNow exactness, adapter ownership, and disposal.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 08 rapid scroll after scheduler unification
verificationRecords.notes: 30 latest-wins adapter frames pass with zero geometry reads; removal of the outer rAF exposes all 30 alternating cold session builds, intentionally retained for the pure-plan cache slices.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 08 exact direct seek and motif preservation
verificationRecords.notes: Chromium and Firefox passed wide/phone measured-paint, direct seek, rewind, authority, endpoint, fit, and launcher checks. Existing shared phone readable-floor diagnostics remain separately classified.
13 focused tests pass; unchanged and precedence-hidden layers no longer increment revisions or notify subscribers.
Rapid sweep passes with zero geometry reads and unchanged canonical session work counters.
14 focused tests pass; repeated settled hrefs no longer write history and active location validates before its equality fast path.
Rapid sweep remains deterministic with zero geometry reads and canonical visual authority.
Typed dataset/style equality helpers and responsive-fit integration compile across all projects.
Seven fit, containment, identity, and conformance tests pass after write diffing.
Rapid canonical sweep passes with unchanged ownership and work counters.
Retained mounted-record and diff helpers compile across all projects.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 12 clone identity and measured-ink handoff
verificationRecords.notes: Chromium and Firefox wide/phone motif, paint-overlap, seek/rewind, authority, endpoint, fit, and launcher checks pass.
Rapid sweep passes with zero owner add/remove churn and unchanged exclusive visual authority.

expectedLearning: Whether one measured-paint browser contract and a pure-plan cache can make canonical equation scrolling responsive without weakening collision certification or multiplying visual runtimes.
allowedWork: Canonical fraction-reader browser verification, scheduler hot path, semantic state diffing, material-owner diffing, pure compositor-plan caching, bounded idle prewarming, and atomic latest-only handoff.
disallowedWork: No semantic or motif changes, no second renderer or scheduler, no mounted-resource cache, no family-wide rollout, and no browser-specific geometry exception.
